items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe has released isolated patches for these issues.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, with the most severe being CVE-2026-34686 (Stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution) and CVE-2026-34653 (Path Traversal leading to arbitrary file system write). It affects multiple versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: PolyShell: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: Critical Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities, including incorrect authorization, improper access control, and stored XSS, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and data theft. It affects various versions of Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot technique. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 containing the fix, but older supported versions remain vulnerable without backported patches.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution and customer account takeover under certain conditions, with mass attacks observed in the wild. Adobe released an emergency fix in September 2025, but many stores remained vulnerable.

items.title: CosmicSting: Critical bug allowing file reading and RCE
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical bug in Adobe Commerce and Magento platforms that allows attackers to read any files, including passwords and secret keys, and can lead to remote code execution. Adobe released a fix in June 2024, and exploitation in the wild has been observed.
